project_type: Next.js 16 app with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, App Router
build_system: npm scripts with Next.js (using bun as runtime since npm/node not available directly)
verification_instructions: 1. Run bun run lint - zero errors expected. 2. Run bun run build - must compile successfully.
environment_constraints: Node.js not directly available - use bun as runtime. RIOT_API_KEY not set in environment. OPEN_INTERNET network mode.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript passes, ESLint passes, build succeeds, no unused imports, responsive Tailwind CSS, semantic HTML.
key_patterns: API route at app/api/riot/route.ts proxies Riot API calls. Riot API client in lib/riot-api.ts uses RiotApiError class with status codes. 401/403 errors are already caught and returned as 503 with user-friendly message.
directory_structure: app/ - Next.js App Router pages and API routes. lib/ - shared utilities (riot-api.ts, types.ts). public/ - static assets.
